display_long_description:
Start Your Big City Adventure!

Get ready for an exciting journey with Trash Cat: Street Run. Step into a colorful 3D city where you must help a fast cat run as far as possible. The street is full of surprises, and you will need quick reflexes to stay safe, collect rewards, and keep moving!

Why You Will Love It:
Fun Running Action: Move left, right, and jump to avoid everything in your way. It is easy to play but gets more exciting as you go faster.

Collect Tasty Fish: Keep an eye out for fish along the track! Collect as many as you can to increase your score and become the top cat.

Dodge Tricky Obstacles: Watch out for mice running on the road, trash cans, and wooden boxes. One wrong move and the run is over!

Escape the Barking Dog: Stay alert because a white dog is always ready to stop your fun. Stay fast to keep ahead of the chase.

Beautiful 3D City: Run through bright streets with realistic buildings and sunny views that look great in VR.

Put on your headset, grab those fish, and help the Trash Cat conquer the city streets today!
